entries.title: Psalms 147:1
segments: When our hearts are right, there is no employment so pleasant as praising God.  That men so generally neglect this most excellent service, is a proof of their exceeding wickedness.

entries.title: Psalms 147:2
segments: Though the Lord may suffer his people to be for a time persecuted and scattered, he will gather them together again and comfort them.

entries.title: Psalms 147:3
segments: The afflicted can always find in God a gracious and almighty Comforter.

entries.title: Psalms 147:4
segments:
Telleth; counteth. 
 
He who gives names to all the stars will not overlook any of his servants.

entries.title: Psalms 147:9
segments: The bounty of God provides for the beasts and the young ravens; how much more for his own children.

entries.title: Psalms 147:10
segments:
The strength of the horse; the war-horse. 
 
  The legs of a man; the strong and active legs of the warrior. Jehovah delights not in military forces, whether of cavalry or foot, because he has no need of their help.  Compare
, which may serve as a commentary on this verse.

entries.title: Psalms 147:11
segments: Outward pomp and power are vian in the sight of God; he looks to the state of the heart.

entries.title: Psalms 147:13
segments: The bars of thy gates; by which they are defended against the assaults of enemies.

entries.title: Psalms 147:15
segments: His word runneth very swiftly; God's word is a swift messenger sent forth to the elements, and the commands which it bears to them from God, they execute immediately.

entries.title: Psalms 147:17
segments:
Ice; hailstones. 
 
  Like morsels; in bits, or small pieces, like morsels of food.

entries.title: Psalms 147:18
segments:
And melteth them; the snow, frost, and ice. 
 
  His wind; the warm south wind, which melts the ice, and causes it to flow off in streams.

entries.title: Psalms 147:20
segments:
They have not known them; that is, the other nations of the earth. 
 
The greatest blessing which God can confer on any nation is a knowledge of himself.
